prompt: Create a vertical 9:16 night photograph, the next instant after the scientist from the second image grabbed the dividing bars. The five lads are squeezed shoulder to shoulder, faces overlapping and stretched, mid-merge. Slight motion blur on the bars, warm bokeh behind, signs blurred and unreadable. Thanks.
